test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution: The correct answer is** 'ubiquitous.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let us discuss the meanings of the given options: • **Ubiquitous: **seeming to be everywhere or in several places at the same time; very common. (एक ही समय में सर्वत्र या अनेक स्‍थानों पर विद्यमान लगने वाला; यत्र, तत्र, सर्वत्र दृश्‍यमान; बहुत आम) • **Celestial: **of the sky or of heaven. (आकाश या स्‍वर्ग से संबंधित) • **Squandered: **to waste time, money, etc. (समय, पैसा आदि बरबाद करना) • **Regressive: **becoming or making something less advanced. (पीछे की ओर जाने या ले जाने वाली; पश्‍चगामी, प्रतिगामी) • In this sentence, we are talking about the publicity of gadgets which was done everywhere that conveyed *that the new products will enhance the happiness of the young people.* Correct Paragraph__: *While the older generation of Indians would buy a new product only when the (1) __previous__ one's useful life had ended, the young generation (2) __tends__ to fall for novelty. Young people want the (3) __latest__ gadgets because they have money and more (4) __access__ to such goods. They are made to believe, by (5) *__ubiquitous__* publicity, that the new products will enhance their happiness.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us see the synonyms of the given words: • Ubiquitous: Everywhere • Celestial: Heavenly 9e:T1184, The correct answer is **'****Worthless.'**
